title.fa: مسخ کافکا: مراقبت خانوادگی، فرسایش آن و جابه‌جایی نقش‌ها
title.en: Kafka's Metamorphosis: family care, its erosion and role reversal
title.nl: Kafka's Metamorfose: familiezorg, erosie en rolwisseling

summary.fa: داستان مرحله‌به‌مرحله نشان می‌دهد خانواده‌ای که به درآمد یکی از اعضا تکیه داشته، وقتی او از کار می‌افتد چگونه از وحشت به تحمل، سپس رد و در پایان آسودگی می‌رسد.
summary.en: The story shows, stage by stage, how a family that depended on one member's income moves from horror to tolerance, rejection and finally relief once he can no longer work.
summary.nl: Het verhaal toont hoe een gezin dat van één inkomen afhing verschuift van afschuw naar verdraagzaamheid, afwijzing en opluchting.

text.fa: نخست خانواده نگران است؛ مادر می‌خواهد پزشک بیاید و پدر و خواهر در را می‌کوبند. با دیدنِ گرگور، مادر از حال می‌رود و پدر با مشت او را به اتاقش می‌راند.
text.en: At first the family is alarmed; the mother asks for a doctor and the father and sister knock at the door. On seeing Gregor the mother collapses and the father drives him back into his room with his fists.
text.nl: At first the family is alarmed; the mother asks for a doctor and the father and sister knock at the door. On seeing Gregor the mother collapses and the father drives him back into his room with his fists.

text.fa: خواهر، گرت، غذا می‌آورد و اتاق را مرتب می‌کند. این مراقبت در متن با دلسوزی آغاز می‌شود ولی خسته‌کننده و طولانی است.
text.en: His sister Grete brings food and tidies the room; the care begins with compassion but is long and wearing.
text.nl: His sister Grete brings food and tidies the room; the care begins with compassion but is long and wearing.

text.fa: پس از دگرگونی، خانواده مستأجر می‌پذیرد؛ و بر پایهٔ پایانِ متن هر سه عضو دیگر کارهای تازه‌ای یافته‌اند. نقشِ نان‌آور از گرگور به دیگران می‌رسد.
text.en: After the change the family takes in lodgers, and by the ending the other three family members have found new jobs; the breadwinner role passes from Gregor to the others.
text.nl: After the change the family takes in lodgers, and by the ending the other three family members have found new jobs; the breadwinner role passes from Gregor to the others.

text.fa: پدر او را با پرتاب سیب مجروح می‌کند؛ سیب در پشتش می‌ماند و بیش از یک ماه زخم باقی است. در متن، همین زخم پدر را به این نتیجه می‌رساند که پسر هنوز عضوی از خانواده است و باید تحملش کرد.
text.en: The father wounds him by throwing apples; one stays lodged in his back and the wound lasts over a month. In the text, this leads the father to see that he is still a family member to be tolerated.
text.nl: The father wounds him by throwing apples; one stays lodged in his back and the wound lasts over a month. In the text, this leads the father to see that he is still a family member to be tolerated.

text.fa: بعد از صحنهٔ ویولن و مستأجرها، خواهر می‌گوید باید از شر این «موجود» خلاص شد و دیگر نباید آن را گرگور دانست؛ پدر موافقت می‌کند.
text.en: After the violin scene with the lodgers, the sister declares they must be rid of the creature and must stop thinking it is Gregor; the father agrees.
text.nl: After the violin scene with the lodgers, the sister declares they must be rid of the creature and must stop thinking it is Gregor; the father agrees.

text.fa: پس از مرگِ گرگور، خانواده به‌جای سوگ طولانی با آسودگی بیرون می‌روند و در تراموا از آیندهٔ بهتر و ازدواج دخترشان سخن می‌گویند.
text.en: After Gregor's death the family, rather than mourning at length, goes out with visible relief, and on the tram speaks of better prospects and the daughter's marriage.
text.nl: After Gregor's death the family, rather than mourning at length, goes out with visible relief, and on the tram speaks of better prospects and the daughter's marriage.

text.fa: این روایتی ادبی از مراقبت و بار آن است؛ برخی منتقدان آن را درباره‌ٔ معلولیت و بار مراقبت می‌خوانند و برخی نماد بیماری یا گناه، و اثر خود هیچ‌کدام را تأیید نمی‌کند. برای سیاست مراقبت باید از پژوهش‌های تجربی استفاده کرد.
text.en: This is a literary account of care and its burden; some critics read it as about disability and caregiving, others as symbolising illness or guilt, and the work endorses none. For care policy, empirical research should be used.
text.nl: This is a literary account of care and its burden; some critics read it as about disability and caregiving, others as symbolising illness or guilt, and the work endorses none. For care policy, empirical research should be used.
